newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish oil refinery operation normal after blast.
newsitem.headline: Turkish oil refinery operation normal after blast.

text.p: An explosion which hit a state Tupras oil refinery in central Turkey on Thursday and killed one worker has not interrupted operations at the the refinery, company officials said.
"This was an individual incident. It did not stop the operation of the refinery," an official told Reuters.
The blast occurred in the early hours of the morning due to gas compression in an asphalt filling tank in the refinery in the town of Kirikkale.
The worker was on top of the tank taking measurements when the explosion happened.
Kirikkale is the third biggest refinery of Tupras, which runs a total of four refineries in Turkey. The government wants to privatise the refineries individually.
